newsitem.title: UK: Lewis to head PolyGram Decca unit.
newsitem.headline: Lewis to head PolyGram Decca unit.

text.p: Roger Lewis has been appointed president of the London-based Decca Record Company, parent company PolyGram NV said on Monday.
Lewis moves from EMI Records UK where he was managing director of the wide-ranging EMI Premier label group, which includes EMI's classical output.
He succeeds Roland Kommerell who retired from Decca at the end of last year after a decade as president.
Decca is a unit of global music and film compay PolyGram. In a number of countries, including the U.S., Decca trades under the London name.
Artists on Decca/London include Luciano Pavarotti, Sir Georg Solti and Kiri Te Kanawa.
